title: Voice settings
body: Configure TTS language and phrase packs. Demo uses browser speech when available.
playbackHint: Read-aloud uses recorded MP3s when present, then browser speech, with on-screen highlighting as fallback.
rwHonestHint: Kinyarwanda read-aloud needs a matching browser voice, audio pack, or cloud service. English voices will never be used for Kinyarwanda phrases.
